canonical.title: KL weekend: Michelin dinner + city playbook

sources.title: MICHELIN Guide KL & Penang 2026 — Full List
sources.claim: KL has 7 Michelin-starred restaurants: one 2★ (Dewakan) and six 1★

sources.title: Dewakan — official site
sources.claim: RM870 nett tasting menu; wine pairings RM353/RM636; Mon–Sat from 6pm

sources.title: Terra Dining — official site
sources.claim: 91G Jalan Aminuddin Baki TTDI; reservations via inline.app; tea pairings available

sources.title: Beta KL — official site
sources.claim: 10 Jalan Perak (near KLCC); Tue–Sun 18:00–23:00; RM300/pp credit card hold required

sources.title: DC by Darren Chin — official site
sources.claim: 44 Persiaran Zaaba TTDI; Wed–Sun dinner, Fri–Sat lunch; Moonbar + 8-seat Cellar omakase ~RM1,200

sources.title: Akar — official site
sources.claim: 109 Jalan Aminuddin Baki TTDI; Mekar dinner RM588++; Sat lunch RM288++; 48h cancellation policy

sources.title: Chim by Chef Noom — official site
sources.claim: L2-03 TSLAW Tower Imbi; seasonal multicourse tasting menus from RM600++

sources.title: Molina — official site
sources.claim: Level 51 FACE STYLE Hotel 1020 Jalan Sultan Ismail; Tue–Sat from 6pm; Sat lunch also available

sources.title: Petronas Twin Towers — official e-ticket
sources.claim: Tue–Sun (closed Mondays); ~MYR 98 non-Malaysian adults; advance booking required; daily visitor cap

sources.title: Islamic Arts Museum Malaysia — visit information
sources.claim: Open 9:30am–6pm daily; RM20 adults; last entry 5:30pm

sources.title: Batu Caves Kuala Lumpur guide
sources.claim: Open daily 6am–9pm; main cave free entry; 272 steps, 15–20 min climb; watch belongings from macaques

sources.title: KL Sentral → Batu Caves transit guide
sources.claim: KTM Komuter 35 min, MYR 2.30–2.60 one-way; Grab 20–35 min ~MYR 25–45

sources.title: Sri Nirwana Maju — MICHELIN Bib Gourmand
sources.claim: Jalan Telawi 3 Bangsar Baru; Bib Gourmand for banana-leaf rice and South Indian curries

sources.title: FutureCIO Malaysia 4th Edition — 24 Jun 2026
sources.claim: June 24 at Hilton KL; 09:00–17:00; USD 1,995 regular; free passes for CIOs and senior IT management

sources.title: Test Automation Summit KL — 25 Jun 2026
sources.claim: June 25 at Connexion Bangsar South; AI-Driven & Sustainable Testing; MYR 499

sources.title: KCD Kuala Lumpur 2026 — 27 Jun
sources.claim: June 27 at The iSpace Plaza Vads TTDI; CNCF cloud-native Kubernetes community event; free admission

sources.title: Masjid Negara — National Mosque KL
sources.claim: Free entry; Sat–Thu 9:30am–12:30pm and 3–6pm; Fri 3–6pm only; robes lent at entrance

sources.title: Jalan Alor street food guide
sources.claim: Bukit Bintang night-food street; liveliest after sunset; satay, char kway teow, WAW chicken wings

sources.title: Dewakan — Malaysia's first 2★ + Green Star restaurant
sources.claim: Darren Teoh's contemporary Malaysian tasting menu; only restaurant in Malaysia with both Michelin 2★ and Green Star

sources.title: KLCC Lake Symphony — Esplanade fountain show
sources.claim: Free nightly light-and-water shows 8:00pm–10:10pm every 30 min; viewable from esplanade outside Suria KLCC
